charter.claim: R-033: after the accepted local-to-abstract handoff, a fresh native source can produce an eligible callback and returned lead while unchanged sources deduplicate, changed sources refresh, unsupported memory ages, and identity-continuous reentry avoids clone or simultaneous local/abstract ownership.
charter.material_proof: The fresh source-bound run must begin from the declared abstract pair/generation and isolate setup from credit. Credit requires accepted native semantic action, exact source/current OMT and observer identities, callback and lead ancestry, before/after memory counts and hashes for unchanged and changed sources, unsupported-lead aging, and reentry records retaining member IDs/generation/route/waypoint with one owner at a time.
charter.current_uncertainty: Whether the abstract-owned source callback yields a new eligible lead and whether the production memory and reentry paths expose all requested transitions under native semantic actions.
material_contradiction: fixture setup, direct state, debug signal, authored lead/report, or presentation output is treated as behavior proof
callback or lead lacks source, observer, accepted-action, run, or executable binding
unchanged-source dedup or changed-source refresh lacks exact before/after identity and count/hash
unsupported memory is claimed aged without an authoritative cadence and removal/expiry record
reentry changes pair/generation or admits clone or simultaneous local/abstract ownership
forbidden_shortcuts: debug emitted sound or injected signal
direct signal, lead, report, operation, member, route, or owner mutation
raw save rewrite after fixture installation
OCR, terminal bytes, or rendered text as gameplay proof
honest_stop_conditions: finish after the first attributable callback/lead and all independently available memory/reentry transitions
finish inconclusive if a requested transition lacks a valid native opportunity or reusable observation
finish contradicted on source, identity, provenance, or ownership violation

witness_fields.value_types: Copy exact JSON values from the journal: false differs from the string "false", and 0 differs from "0". Do not coerce native string facts.
witness_fields.smallest_supported_claim: Your conclusion limited to cited facts
witness_fields.causal_account: Why the observed facts support that conclusion

checks.value.surface.facts.FIELD: Exact observed value; nested JSON paths supported

witness_fields.contradictions: List every supplied contradiction with its citation_id and meaning
